definition.en: Energy transferred because of a temperature difference.
A quantity measured by a thermometer that tells how hot or cold something is.
definition.zh: 由温度计测量，表示物体冷热程度的量。

definition.en: An instrument that measures temperature rather than an amount of heat.
definition.zh: 测量温度的仪器，不是测量物体含有多少热。

definition.en: Net transfer of energy from a hotter region toward a colder region because of their temperature difference.
definition.zh: 因温差而使能量从较热处向较冷处净传递。

definition.en: A material through which heat transfers comparatively easily under comparable conditions. Metals are generally good conductors.
definition.zh: 在可比条件下，较容易传热的材料。金属通常是热的良导体。

definition.en: A material through which heat transfers comparatively slowly under comparable conditions. It still transfers heat.
definition.zh: 在可比条件下，传热较慢的材料。它仍然会传热。

definition.en: The state in which bodies have the same temperature and no net heat transfer between them.
definition.zh: 物体温度相同，彼此之间没有净传热的状态。

definition.en: Reducing heat transfer into or out of an object. Insulation supplies no energy and does not make cold.
definition.zh: 减慢能量以热的形式进出物体。隔热不供能，也不制造冷。

definition.en: In this lesson, a model graph of water temperature against elapsed heating time. Its points are predictions, not measurements.
definition.zh: 本课中表示水温随加热时间变化的模型图。图上各点是模型预计值，不是实测。

definition.en: In this lesson, a model graph of temperature against elapsed cooling time with the surroundings held constant.
definition.zh: 本课中，周围环境保持不变时，表示温度随冷却时间变化的模型图。

definition.en: A quantity describing how much matter is in an object. This model controls the water mass in grams.
definition.zh: 表示物体含有多少物质的量。模型用克控制水的质量。

definition.en: The rate at which energy is transferred. A heater of greater power supplies more energy in the same time.
definition.zh: 单位时间内传递能量的多少。功率较大的加热器在相同时间内供给更多能量。

definition.en: An increase in size. Most substances expand when warmed under ordinary conditions if free to change size.
definition.zh: 尺寸增加。在通常条件下，大多数物质温度升高且可自由变形时会膨胀。

definition.en: A decrease in size. Most substances contract when cooled under ordinary conditions if free to change size.
definition.zh: 尺寸减小。在通常条件下，大多数物质温度降低且可自由变形时会收缩。

definition.en: A comparison that changes one relevant condition while holding the other relevant conditions the same.
definition.zh: 只改变一个相关条件，其余相关条件保持相同的比较。

definition.en: The difference between two temperatures. A smaller difference from the surroundings gives slower temperature change in this cooling model.
definition.zh: 两个温度之间的差。在这个冷却模型中，与环境的温差较小时，温度变化较慢。
